system.description: You may quickly send a surge of chakra through your body, enhancing your next attack with elemental power, so unwieldy that it becomes difficult to control. You may spend 2 Superiority Die. When you do, your next attack is made at disadvantage and you cannot gain the benefit of advantage as part of this attack. Additionally, you cannot gain jutsu based bonuses to the attack result. On a successful hit, you treat this attack as a critical hit.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
